examples.en: Here you are. Thanks, Dan.

phrases.usage: 表示计划或打算做某事

grammar.title: 现在进行时 (Present Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示说话时正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 描述说话人此刻正在进行的动作

examples.en: What are you doing?
I'm making a bookcase.

grammar.title: be going to 表示将来
grammar.definition: 表示已经计划或决定要做的将来动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are + going to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 表达明确的计划或意图

examples.en: What are you going to do now?
I'm going to paint it pink.

grammar.title: 特殊疑问句 (Special Questions)
